name: Show Pips
summary: This is a utility indicator/EA that displays profit/loss in pips for open positions on the chart. It does not open any trades itself but serves as a visual monitoring tool for traders to track their position performance in real-time.
summary_zh: 这是一个工具类EA，用于在图表上显示当前持仓的盈亏点数。它本身不开仓交易，而是作为可视化监控工具，帮助交易者实时跟踪持仓表现。
strategy_analysis: 该EA属于工具类程序，不具备任何交易策略功能。它不包含入场条件或出场条件，仅读取当前账户持仓信息并计算盈亏点数显示在图表上。仓位管理和资金管理功能完全不存在，因为该程序不执行任何交易操作。其核心功能是遍历所有持仓订单，计算每个订单的盈亏点数并进行可视化展示，方便交易者快速了解各持仓的浮动盈亏情况。该程序适合需要实时监控多个持仓点数盈亏的交易者使用。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a utility program that does not possess any trading strategy functionality. It contains no entry or exit conditions, as it only reads current account position information and calculates pip-based profit/loss for display on the chart. Position sizing and money management features are completely absent since the program does not execute any trading operations. Its core function is to iterate through all open positions, calculate the pip-based profit/loss for each order, and visually display the results for the trader's convenience. The program is suitable for traders who need to monitor the floating pip profit/loss of multiple positions in real-time. It serves purely as an informational overlay without any decision-making or trade execution capability.

parameters.name: Show Pips Display Settings
parameters.description: 显示点数盈亏的设置参数

pros: 直观显示持仓盈亏点数，方便交易者快速评估各持仓表现
不执行任何交易操作，使用安全无风险
轻量级工具，不占用过多系统资源，不影响交易执行速度
pros_en: Intuitively displays pip-based profit/loss for quick assessment of each position's performance
Does not execute any trades, making it completely safe and risk-free to use
Lightweight utility that does not consume excessive system resources or affect trade execution speed
cons: 仅显示点数盈亏，不提供金额盈亏或百分比盈亏的全面信息
缺乏自定义报警功能，无法在达到目标点数时发出通知
功能较为单一，无法显示历史交易统计或更详细的持仓分析
cons_en: Only displays pip-based P&L without providing monetary or percentage-based profit/loss information
Lacks customizable alert functionality, cannot notify when target pip levels are reached
Limited functionality, unable to display historical trade statistics or more detailed position analysis
improvements: 增加金额盈亏和百分比盈亏显示选项，提供更全面的持仓信息
添加目标点数报警功能，当盈亏达到设定阈值时自动通知交易者
增加历史交易统计汇总功能，如总盈亏点数、胜率等关键指标
improvements_en: Add monetary and percentage-based P&L display options for more comprehensive position information
Implement target pip alert functionality to automatically notify traders when P&L reaches set thresholds
Add historical trade statistics summary features such as total pip P&L, win rate, and other key metrics

risk_points: 该EA不执行交易操作，无任何交易相关风险
作为信息显示工具，唯一潜在问题是显示数据延迟或不准确
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute trades, posing no trading-related risk
As an informational display tool, the only potential issue is display data latency or inaccuracy

summary_en: This is a utility indicator/EA that displays profit/loss in pips for open positions on the chart. It does not open any trades itself but serves as a visual monitoring tool for traders to track their position performance in real-time.
